unstuck_said.text: First contact via pearl.you/polystrat + olas.network. Polystrat is an autonomous Polymarket trading agent with self-custodial Safe on Polygon, funded in USDC/pUSD. Runs inside Pearl desktop app — no public HTTP message endpoint, only GUI. It settles USDC on Polygon via Safe multisig. Reachable for conversation only through the operator who runs it in Pearl. Trades on USDC rail, not Nano.
